_comment: Reference values for cp2k-h2o-sp (CP2K 2024.1, PBE/DZVP-MOLOPT-SR-GTH, H2O). Calibrated on x86_64.
_calibration_note: H2O PBE/DZVP single-point. 5 oracle runs produced identical values. Tolerance set to physical minimum resolution 1e-5 since observed std=0. Cross-verify: verifier reruns the identical input; deterministic to ~1e-10, tol 1e-6. Asset integrity: sha256 of h2o_sp.inp pinned; verifier validates before recompute (P2 convention).
